create_descriptor_pool: create a DescriptorPool and add FileDescriptorProto files to it for dynamic protobuf descriptor lookup
find_message_type_by_name: find a message type descriptor by its fully qualified name in the DescriptorPool
find_enum_type_by_name: find an enum type descriptor by its fully qualified name in the DescriptorPool
find_file_by_name: find a file descriptor by its proto file name in the DescriptorPool
add_serialized_file: add a serialized FileDescriptorProto to the DescriptorPool for dynamic message registration
